_: The talk camera, its two-light rig and the NPC look-at (workstream TALK, Nov 8 2026; design/godot-dialogue.md 'The talk camera'). One standard shot for every attendant and the bartender, used by the conversation screen (scripts/dialogue/dialogue_ui.gd) and the shop list (scripts/shop.gd) through scripts/story/talk_camera.gd. Per-NPC overrides under 'npc', keyed by the attendant's id (data/story/attendants.json, data/story/cucos/cucos.json): any key of 'shot', 'lights' or 'look' may be overridden there; leave an NPC out to take the standard.

shot._: A medium close-up: frame_h metres of the person visible top to bottom at their eye distance (head and shoulders), the eyes eye_line of the way down from the top. The camera stands at the NPC's eye height, distance m from the eyes toward the player, side m to the NPC's left (the player's right) and turned back onto the face. When something is in the way (a wall, the player standing closer) it comes in to min_distance at most, the FOV opening so frame_h stays the same. ease_s: the move in and out (cubic in-out). portrait_frame_h: frame_h on a screen taller than wide (a phone), so the shoulders still fit.

lights._: Two lights carried by the talk camera, lighting only the NPC being talked to (render layer 20, which nothing else in the mall uses; nothing baked sees them). key: from the camera side, up and to screen-left; fill: lower, to screen-right, on the side the key leaves dark. Offsets are camera-local metres (x right, y up, z back toward the viewer). Energies fade in and out with the camera move.

years._: Per year multipliers on both energies (the 2026 interior is whiter and brighter).

look._: The NPC looks at the camera: the eyes lead (eye_tau s), the head follows (head_tau s) within head_yaw / head_pitch degrees of the body's front, the eyes take the rest within eye_yaw / eye_pitch. Saccades: every saccade_s seconds the eyes jump up to saccade_deg (between the viewer's eyes). Blinks every blink_s seconds, blink_len s long. blend_s: in and out of the idle head.

eyes_ubc._: The UBC bodies (models/ubc) have no eye bones and no eyelids: the eyes are one mesh skinned to the head with a fisheye-mapped iris texture (front at uv 0.496,0.501; 90 degrees toward the body's +x at +dx, toward +y at +dy; the two eyes are mirrored in x). The gaze slides the iris texture; a blink draws the lid colour (the skin tone x lid_k) down over the eye from lid_top (uv units along +dy). Read from the mesh, Nov 8 2026 (both sexes share the eye mesh).
